headline: PSC to recruit 5,000 doctors in 51st special BCS
summary: The Public Service Commission has issued a circular for 5,000 health cadre posts, including assistant surgeons and dental surgeons.
details: The Public Service Commission (PSC) has issued a circular for the 51st special Bangladesh Civil Service (BCS) exam to recruit 5,000 doctors for government hospitals.
The recruitment drive will include 4,700 assistant surgeons and 300 assistant dental surgeons under the BCS health cadre.
Candidates with MBBS, BDS or equivalent degrees can apply online from October 1 to October 25.
The application fee is set at Tk 200. Applicants will undergo a 200-mark preliminary exam and a 100-mark competency-based viva voce.
The preliminary test will allocate 20 marks each to Bangla, English, Bangladesh affairs and international affairs, with 10 marks each for mental ability and mathematical reasoning.
The remaining 100 marks of the preliminary exam will cover subjects related to the health cadre.
The last special BCS recruitment for the health cadre was the 48th BCS, where 3,120 candidates passed and 3,120 were nominated as surgeons.
The 49th BCS was a special exam for recruiting 683 teachers for government colleges, while the 50th BCS is a general examination currently in progress.
caption:
5,000 new doctors are coming to government hospitals. Applications for the 51st special BCS open October 1.

The recruitment drive will include 4,700 assistant surgeons and 300 assistant dental surgeons under the BCS health cadre.

Candidates with MBBS, BDS or equivalent degrees can apply online from October 1 to October 25.

The application fee is set at Tk 200. Applicants will undergo a 200-mark preliminary exam and a 100-mark competency-based viva voce.

The preliminary test will allocate 20 marks each to Bangla, English, Bangladesh affairs and international affairs, with 10 marks each for mental ability and mathematical reasoning.

The remaining 100 marks of the preliminary exam will cover subjects related to the health cadre.

The last special BCS recruitment for the health cadre was the 48th BCS, where 3,120 candidates passed and 3,120 were nominated as surgeons.

The 49th BCS was a special exam for recruiting 683 teachers for government colleges, while the 50th BCS is a general examination currently in progress.

headline_marked: Dengue surge: [[8 more die as 1,782 hospitalized]] in 24 hours
headline: Dengue surge: 8 more die as 1,782 hospitalized in 24 hours
summary: The death toll for the year has reached 209, with over 69,000 hospitalizations recorded by the health directorate.
details: Eight people died from dengue in the last 24 hours, according to the Health Emergency Operation Center and Control Room of the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS).
During the same period, 1,782 patients were admitted to various hospitals across the country.
The distribution of new admissions includes 371 patients from the Dhaka division (outside city corporations), 288 from Chattogram, and 286 from Khulna.
Within the capital, 194 patients were admitted in Dhaka South City Corporation and 151 in Dhaka North City Corporation.
Other regional admissions include 164 from Barishal, 130 from Rajshahi, 108 from Mymensingh, 73 from Rangpur, and 17 from Sylhet.
The total number of dengue deaths this year has risen to 209, while total hospitalizations have reached 69,149.
